changes: Hardened the current public HOUSE surface: generalized legacy donor/current-instance labels that unnecessarily exposed unit/neighborhood clues while preserving the unresolved donor-vs-current-instance contradiction.
Added noindex,nofollow to /house/, /house/expert.html and /house/spatial/ compatibility HTML. This reduces search indexing but is not access control.
Privacy boundary: current working-tree labels are sanitized; prior public Git history may still contain earlier labels and was not rewritten automatically.

Restored HOUSE→BODY context attachment directly on canonical /house/: the selected spatial address plus timestamped public projection metadata is written only to the existing browser-local ENV-0 envelope.
BODY CONTEXT explicitly remains context-only: selected address != presence and correlation != causation; no BODY observation enters house/state.json and no HA/HOUSEBUS authority changes.
Corrected stale release checks left by the transitional portal pass: human entry and FIELD direct link are /house/; /house/spatial/ is compatibility/substrate only.
CARE can selectively project one episode into the existing HUMAN PORT composer as a local draft; the user still edits/chooses Share or Copy and selects the transport.
The HUMAN PORT projection omits HOUSE spatial address, episode id, timestamp and all other local episodes by default.
User-reported external sharing is treated only as evidence that human-world consequence exists; exact private message contents and recipient interpretation remain unrecovered.
Added CARE as a canonical HOUSE projection for browser-local continuity: OBSERVED → ACTION → RECEIPT → RETURN.
CARE episodes are localStorage-only, exportable as local JSON, and never committed to repository state or sent to Home Assistant/HOUSEBUS.
CARE can hand one explicit ACTION packet to Dayline using the existing sessionStorage handoff; recipient navigation does not create HOUSE or device truth.
Closing a CARE episode requires an entered receipt/outcome; OPEN and WATCH remain distinct states.
Projection hashes are now addressable at the canonical root (`/house/#PLAN`, `#TRACE`, etc.); changing views updates the hash without navigation.
Dayline DEPTH / PROJECTIONS now links HOUSE directly to `/house/` instead of the compatibility alias.
HOUSE confluence v0.2 encodes the one-canonical-human-entry law; machine/browser verification comes first, while bounded physical RETURN is required only for claims about the physical instance.
Converged HOUSE onto one canonical human-facing root: /house/ now directly hosts the spatial/state instrument rather than a dashboard that links onward.
Preserved the former generated HOUSE dashboard as /house/expert.html for technical state/runtime inspection and BODY↔HOUSE local context depth.
Collapsed /house/spatial/ into a compatibility redirect to /house/; spatial model and TRACE law assets remain under /house/spatial/ as substrate rather than a second UI authority.
FIELD INDEX and CURRENT now point HOUSE to /house/; the obsolete user-directed HOUSE hold was removed because HOUSE was explicitly reselected.
Added a compact timestamped public HOUSE state witness inside the root without claiming live presence, live safety or actuation authority.
Made /house/spatial/ the explicit primary human-facing HOUSE entry while preserving /house/ as the expert state/runtime projection.
Added a prominent ENTER THE HOUSE portal at the top of /house/ so shared root links lead humans toward the spatial model before expert details.
Added direct HOUSE / SPATIAL navigation from FIELD INDEX and made the HOUSE capability aperture recognize both /house/ and /house/spatial/.
Added BODY↔HOUSE same-origin local context bridge: HOUSE can display the latest browser-local BODY return without committing it.
Added explicit ATTACH HOUSE CONTEXT → BODY action carrying only public projection timestamp/health class plus optional area label.
Preserved authority boundary: Home Assistant / HOUSEBUS owns runtime device truth/actuation; local bridge is context only.
No personal BODY state is written to house/state.json or the repository.
Transplanted the bounded HOUSE / FIELD public projection from house-field-v01 onto current master without merging the stale branch wholesale.
Added APP-041 Spatial State Engine lineage: Spatial Ledger v0.1 -> Spatial Engine v0.3, with the Sep 9 single-file app retained as an operational donor.
Made the authority split explicit: Spatial State owns address/geometry/evidence; Home Assistant / HOUSEBUS owns device truth and actuation; MQTT is transport only.
Kept the public page projection-only and timestamped; no public control endpoint was introduced.
Registered HOUSE / FIELD in FIELD INDEX, federation atlas and RETURN ledger.
Added /house/spatial/ as the runnable Spatial State Engine workbench with PLAN/RCP/SURFACE/SECTION/3D/FIELD/ATLAS projections over one addressed substrate.
Corrected the earlier overly restrictive 2D-first wording: 3D is allowed whenever it preserves identity, provenance and uncertainty; unmeasured Z remains explicitly unknown.
Drafted /house/confluence.json to coordinate HOUSE instance/substrate/state/runtime/projection layers without vocabulary collapse.
Restored the shared bottom-left showcase route adapter to HOUSE and linked the Spatial State current head.
State refreshed from the live control plane; runtime table gained a verified backup row (HA backup manager, baseline present).
Clarified reality-task boundary: ordinary chores remain private Dayline/runtime tasks; HOUSE receives only durable physical/resource/state evidence, never personal chore lists or urgency.
Added session-only Shopping → HOUSE FIT projection at the canonical /house/ root; /house/spatial/ remains a compatibility redirect and does not regain UI authority.
FIT compares a Shopping candidate's OPERATING W/D/H envelope against explicit user-measured available W/D/H at the selected HOUSE address, with optional 90-degree plan rotation.
FIT PASS/FAIL is dimensional envelope only; doorway path, utilities, ventilation, load, cat clearance and installation remain explicit residue.
HOUSE does not mutate Shopping lifecycle/candidate state and Shopping fit does not mutate canonical HOUSE geometry, HA/HOUSEBUS state or actuation.
Closed the Shopping FIT session loop: CHECK ENVELOPE now emits house-shopping-fit-return/v0.1 as OFFER_ONLY / EVIDENCE_ONLY; RETURN SHOPPING ensures a current screen result exists before navigation.
HOUSE FIT return preserves exact Shopping item/state/source evidence metadata and selected HOUSE address plus candidate/available dimensions.
FIT source panel renders Shopping-owned semantic evidence pattern/text without reclassifying it; dimensional PASS/FAIL remains separate HOUSE screening truth.
CLEAR removes both inbound fit handoff and pending fit return; no canonical HOUSE geometry or HA/HOUSEBUS state is mutated.
